get_state_of_obj: get the current state value of a ManagedObject by querying its object_states metadata using a state name key
set_state_of_obj: set a state value on a ManagedObject by writing to its object_states user_attributes subconfig and saving it
ObjectStateSpec_is_affordance_of_obj: check if a ManagedObject can have a given ObjectStateSpec by comparing its semantic_class against accepted_semantic_classes
BooleanObjectState_toggle: toggle a boolean state on a ManagedObject by flipping its current value and returning the new state
ObjectStateMachine_get_snapshot_dict: collect a snapshot of all active object states across the scene as a nested dict keyed by state name and object handle
